proof: Equivariance gives f(sigma)=f(pi sigma)=pi f(sigma). Hence f(sigma) must be a fixed point of every stabilizer element.
theorem: For an equivariant deterministic selector f and state sigma, every automorphism pi in Stab(sigma) must fix f(sigma). If a nontrivial stabilizer element moves every channel label, no unique BRC6 output exists.
